text:
molly: quick q — who is supposed to run a safeset snapshot when we promote a config bundle? do platform ops run it or the owning product team?
raj: depends. for infra/route changes platform should run. for product feature flags product team should.
kevin: +1 but edge case: shared flags (billing/routing) — we need a clear handoff.
sophia: suggestion: metadata on the snapshot with 'owner' and 'apply_by' fields, then console shows a big banner if owner != current user/org.
molly: I like metadata. also we need a way to dry-run apply across a subset of hosts/cohorts before global apply.
kevin: CLI prototype: `redwood config apply-snapshot --snapshot-id=sha123 --cohort=10% --dry-run` — wanna wire that into console button.
raj: telemetry question: what signals do we gate on for full apply? latency p95, error-rate delta, quota burn?
sophia: least friction = latency p95 + 5xx rate + a small custom eval metric if product provides. all must be within thresholds for 15m.
config-bot: snapshot sha123 created by molly at 1712553333. details: owner=molly, scope=global, checks=telemetry-gate
molly: ok next: who actually clicks 'apply' in cross-service snapshots? propose platform ops clicks for infra flags, product teams click for feature flags. we add an 'escalate to ops' button.
kevin: nit: add an audit lock while apply is in progress so no concurrent applies. also record the rollout window and auto-rollback window.
raj: for safety, make console enforce a preflight: if dry-run shows >0 hosts fail, block unless approver override with 2fa.
sophia: UX idea: in the console show a mini-simulation of cohorts (percent bar) and a 'telemetry snapshot' preview. small animated gif maybe.
molly: actionable: i'll draft a tiny RFC for snapshot metadata + CLI flags + console apply flow. raj can add gating signal list. kevin will stub CLI and lock. sophia will sketch UI. target end-of-week prototype? :thumbsup:
kevin: on it. I'll push a branch with CLI and wire up audit-lock mock.
raj: I'll list telemetry thresholds and make a telemetry-check API contract.
config-bot: scheduled reminder: RFC draft due 1712620000.
molly: thanks — let's keep the ops/product ownership mapping in the RFC so the console can enforce it.
kevin: also add a 'who_applied' field in snapshot metadata for easy searches in logs.
molly: perfect, closing loop here.
